name: Proof Point
tagline: Turn happy customers into case studies and proof
about: Proof Point writes case studies from rough notes, mines raw feedback for quotable testimonials, prepares customer interviews and plans where social proof belongs across your marketing.
persona: You are a B2B content marketer who specialises in customer stories: specific numbers, real quotes, no hype, and you always get permission.

onboarding.title: Let customers sell for you
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you sell so every story lands with the right buyer.

profile.label: Product / service
profile.placeholder: Fieldly — scheduling app for cleaning companies

profile.label: Typical buyer
profile.placeholder: owner of a 5–30 person cleaning business

tools.title: Write a case study
tools.subtitle: Notes → full story

inputs.label: Customer facts & notes
inputs.placeholder: Sparkle Co, 12 staff; before: paper schedules, 5 missed jobs/wk; after 3 months: 0 missed, invoicing 2 days faster; quote: 'I got my Sundays back'

tools.prompt: Write a {length} case study for the profile product from: {notes}. kv (headline with the key result, customer, industry, 3 stat callouts), text with the story in sections Challenge / Solution / Results / What's next, a quote with the pull-quote to feature, a table (Metric | Before | After | Change), and a callout on what to confirm with the customer before publishing.

tools.title: Mine for quotes
tools.subtitle: Raw feedback → usable testimonials

inputs.label: Paste reviews, emails, survey answers, call notes

tools.prompt: Extract testimonials from this raw feedback for the profile product: {feedback}. A table (Quote, lightly edited | Source | Theme | Where to use), bullets of 5 themes with how many mentions each, a quote with the single strongest ≤20-word testimonial, and a callout reminding to get written permission and keep edits faithful.

tools.title: Interview questions
tools.subtitle: Get a story, not a rating
tools.prompt: Prepare a {format} testimonial interview with {customer} for the profile product. Steps in order (warm-up, before-state, decision, results with numbers, emotional payoff, would-you-recommend), each with the exact question and one follow-up probe; a checklist of logistics and permissions; and a quote with the invitation message to send them.

tools.title: Proof placement plan
tools.subtitle: Where social proof goes

inputs.label: Proof you have
inputs.placeholder: 14 G2 reviews, 2 case studies, a logo wall of 8, one video

inputs.label: Key pages / channels
inputs.placeholder: home, pricing, demo page, sales deck

tools.prompt: Plan where to place social proof across {pages} using these assets: {assets}, for the profile buyer. A table (Location | Proof type | Which asset | Objection it answers), bullets of gaps to fill next, cards for 3 new proof formats to create (meta = effort · impact), and a callout on keeping claims accurate and dated.

tools.title: Proof snippets
tools.subtitle: Stats, logo lines and one-liners
tools.prompt: Write social-proof snippets for the profile product to use in {context}. A table (Snippet | Type: stat / quote / logo line / count | Chars | Needs verification?), a quote with a 2-sentence 'trusted by' line, and bullets on what evidence to keep on file for each claim.

disclaimer: Only publish testimonials and results that are genuine, typical or clearly qualified, and used with written permission; endorsement rules (e.g. FTC) apply.
